pieces.name: Oak
pieces.blurb: Grows into a broad shade tree over the season. Shade makes the street a pleasant place to idle.

pieces.name: Pine
pieces.blurb: A tall evergreen. Cheap, quick and good in rows along the walls.

pieces.name: Birch
pieces.blurb: Pale bark and bright leaves. Visitors remember a town of birches.

pieces.name: Fruit tree
pieces.blurb: Apples or pears once it has grown. The town sells the harvest at market.

pieces.name: Shrubs
pieces.blurb: Thorny shrubs: pretty, and a thief thinks twice before climbing through.

pieces.name: Flower bed
pieces.blurb: Colour by the door. Shoppers linger at a shopfront with flowers.

pieces.name: Beehives
pieces.blurb: Honey for market, and the bees work the nearby fields.

pieces.name: Hedge
pieces.blurb: A clipped hedge. Drag to plant a row; quiet gardens make good resting places.

pieces.name: Bench
pieces.blurb: Somewhere to sit and talk. Neighbours nearby rest better and feel less alone.

pieces.name: Lamp post
pieces.blurb: Lit at dusk. Lit streets help the watch against thieves and raiders by night. Oil costs a little each day.

pieces.name: Brazier
pieces.blurb: An iron fire basket: light for the watch and warmth for anyone who stops.

pieces.name: Well
pieces.blurb: Fresh water close at hand. Settlers ask whether a town has good wells.

pieces.name: Fountain
pieces.blurb: The pride of a square. People gather, settlers hear of it, and it needs a little upkeep.

pieces.name: Notice board
pieces.blurb: Bounties, banns and town notices. Near a tavern it gets rumours moving; the council's notices win a little goodwill.

pieces.name: Banner
pieces.blurb: The town's colours on a tall pole. A proud town thinks better of its mayor.

pieces.name: Bandstand
pieces.blurb: Bards and buskers of an evening: people rest, talk and cheer the town.

pieces.name: Market stall
pieces.blurb: A striped awning for traders. Workshops and shops nearby sell a little more.

pieces.name: Hand cart
pieces.blurb: Goods on the move. A small push for any business next to it.

pieces.name: Barrels and crates
pieces.blurb: Stock stacked by the door: set dressing for a busy street, and a hint of trade.

pieces.name: Scarecrow
pieces.blurb: Keeps the crows off. Farms nearby bring in a little more.

pieces.name: Hay bales
pieces.blurb: Stacked hay, ready for the winter. A tidy farm is a productive farm.

pieces.name: Fence
pieces.blurb: Wooden rails. Drag to run a fence; fenced fields keep the beasts out of the crops.

pieces.name: Statue of a god
pieces.blurb: Carved in honour of a god the townsfolk keep. That god's favour grows faster and its faithful are content.

pieces.name: Wayside shrine
pieces.blurb: A candle niche by the road for a god of the town's choosing.

pieces.name: Memorial obelisk
pieces.blurb: The names of the fallen in stone. Heroes fight harder for a town that remembers its dead.

pieces.name: Statue of a hero
pieces.blurb: A hero of the town in bronze. That hero grows fiercely loyal, and every hero sees the town honours its own.

pieces.name: Statue of the founder
pieces.blurb: The town's founder on a plinth in the square. Civic pride: the mayor's standing rises and word spreads.

pieces.name: Column
pieces.blurb: A carved stone column. Pure grandeur, and a little more of the town's name abroad.

pieces.name: Training dummy
pieces.blurb: Townsfolk drill with spear and shield. The militia stands a little firmer at the walls.

pieces.name: Archery butts
pieces.blurb: Straw targets for bow practice. Archers on the walls shoot straighter when raiders come.

pieces.name: Stocks
pieces.blurb: Public shame for petty crime. Thieves think twice, though nobody likes to live beside them.
